## Mission

Exploring how technology can expand human potential and empower people to achieve more together.

## Background & Trajectory

1. **Fundamental Science (Computational Astrophysics, Ph.D. 2018)**
   My journey began with fundamental science, studying the universe through computational astrophysics, numerical simulations, and statistical modeling. Conducted 3,140 numerical simulations (>100 TB, 25k supercomputer node-hours on TACC) of 1-million-body globular clusters ($O(N^3)$ N-body and $O(N \log N)$ Monte Carlo dynamics) to extract a 17M x 14 database of binary black holes and evaluate gravitational wave detection prospects for space-borne detectors (LISA). Fellow in the LSST Data Science Fellowship Program (2016–2018).

2. **Applied Machine Learning & Decision Systems**
   I subsequently moved into applied machine learning, building decision systems for consumer products, marketplaces, and advertising technology—spanning real-time contextual recommendation engines from mobility signals, marketplace pricing and GenAI request flows, and deep-learning performance advertising analytics, causal lift, and demand mining.

3. **Entrepreneurship, Open Research & Human-Centered AI**
   Entrepreneurship brought a different perspective: understanding what people actually need, how they make decisions, and why technically promising solutions sometimes fail in the real world.
   Across these experiences, one question has remained central:
   **How can we use technology to help individuals become more capable and enable people to collaborate more effectively?**

## Philosophy & Epistemology

- **Collaboration First**: I believe humanity’s greatest achievements emerge through collaboration. Intelligence matters, but so do communication, trust, complementary capabilities, incentives, and the freedom to make meaningful choices.
- **Technology as a Means**: Technology is a means rather than an end. Its value should ultimately be measured by how it improves people’s opportunities, autonomy, relationships, and quality of life.
- **Scientific Rigor & Practical Experimentation**: My approach combines scientific curiosity with practical experimentation: challenge assumptions, build working systems, measure outcomes, learn from failure, and revise our understanding.

## Intellectual Interests (Continuing Explorations)

*Note: These are continuing intellectual interests and active engineering explorations, not claims of completed research or established scientific findings.*

- **Collective Intelligence**: How do individual capabilities combine to produce collective outcomes?
- **Human–AI Collaboration**: How can intelligent systems augment human judgment and agency?
- **Organizational Intelligence**: How do communication, coordination, trust, and incentives shape collaboration?
- **Complex Adaptive Systems**: How do interactions among individuals give rise to emergent social and organizational behavior?
- **Decision Intelligence**: How can information, feedback, and experimentation improve decisions?
- **Human Potential**: How can technology make learning, opportunity, and meaningful participation more accessible?
- **AI and Society**: How might increasingly capable intelligence change the ways we work, cooperate, and live?

## Open-Source & Founder Projects

- **[Open Learning Lab](https://github.com/domijin/open-learning-lab)**: An open experiment in evidence-driven personalized learning (`goal -> hypothesis -> experiment -> observation/evidence -> finding -> decision`). Optimizes durable, transferable capability outside the tutoring session rather than conversational fluency.
- **[baby-AI](https://github.com/domijin/baby-AI)**: Open-specs, receipt-verified edge-deployed household agent (<$200 BOM: Raspberry Pi 5 + Hailo-8L + ReSpeaker 4-Mic Array) that learns verbally without shipping personal data off-device. Every claim is backed by a cryptographically signed evaluation receipt.
- **[Life Hack: iMessage AI Router](https://domij.info/beta/)**: A low-bandwidth HCI harness routing iMessage and satellite text channels to internet-connected reasoning agents when normal browsing is constrained or unavailable.
- **[Kin Domi, Inc.](https://kindomi.net/)**: Building human-centered AI and community systems that empower senior independence, dignity, and intergenerational wisdom.
- **[Agent-Based Advertising System & Observations](https://github.com/domijin/observations_in_advertising)**: Architectural specifications and economic analysis of scaling laws, demand mining, adaptive marketing, and multi-agent control planes for sub-50ms real-time decision systems.
- **[LibertyEarth](https://github.com/domijin/LibertyEarth)** & **[The Future Project](https://github.com/domijin/future)**: Open-source living archives exploring collaborative governance, social contracts, and actionable technical strategies.
- **[HackerTube RSS](https://github.com/domijin/HackerTube)**: Curated, subscribable RSS feeds of high-signal technical talks from Hacker News (2007–2026).

## What I’m Looking For

I enjoy working with intellectually curious people who combine ambitious questions with rigorous thinking and practical execution.

I’m particularly interested in connecting with **researchers, lead AI teams, builders, and early-stage founder-centric investors** who value interdisciplinary thinking, experimentation, human-centered technology, and long-term impact.
